Detachable lens unit lets you mount it in tight spaces or on a magnetic base

Lower-light footage shows noticeable noise compared with larger action sensors
searchable_text: Ultra-compact waterproof action camera for cyclists, snorkellers, kids, pets, and sports fans wanting hands-free footage. 4K60 video, detachable lens unit, and a lightweight design make it ideal for mounting in tight spaces on helmets, boats, and bikes.

name: Panasonic Lumix GH7 (2024)
summary: A video-focused Micro Four Thirds body offering 5.7K60 recording and advanced filmmaking tools in a compact frame.
pros: Records 5.7K 60p internally, offering wide cropping and reframing room in post
Five-axis in-body stabilisation with Dual I.S. 2 works well for handheld walking shots
Includes Apple Log and V-Log recording with a wide dynamic range for grading
cons: Micro Four Thirds sensor is smaller than APS-C or full-frame, reducing low-light performance
Fan-cooled system adds an external unit that is not ideal for discreet shooting
Less effective than full-frame in shallow depth-of-field portraits
searchable_text: Micro Four Thirds mirrorless camera for independent filmmakers, travel videographers, and landscape photographers. 5.7K60 recording, V-Log, strong in-body stabilisation, and an electronic viewfinder suit documentary work, travel films, and compact video rigs.

name: Sigma BF (2024)
summary: A minimalist full-frame L-mount camera with a clean, dial-free design built for focused, deliberate shooting.
pros: Compact 383g body with a clean, button-light design that encourages thoughtful shooting
Full-frame 24.6MP sensor delivers detailed files with pleasing natural colour
Compatible with the L-mount alliance so Sigma and Leica lenses are both usable
cons: No in-body stabilisation and no viewfinder, which makes handheld low-light work harder
Video is limited to 4K30, which is restrictive for filmmakers wanting high frame rates
Its minimal dial layout means menu diving is needed to change many settings
searchable_text: Minimalist full-frame mirrorless camera for street photographers, portrait shooters, and enthusiasts who value simplicity. Compact L-mount body with a clean, button-light design suits everyday carry, candid street scenes, and thoughtful portraits. A good pick for photographers who prefer focus on composition over menus.

name: Panasonic Lumix GH6 (2022)
summary: A video-focused hybrid camera offering 5.7K recording, high frame rates, and dual-axis-capable in-body stabilisation.
pros: Records 5.7K30 and 4K120 with 10-bit 4:2:2 internal recording for flexible grading
Five-axis in-body stabilisation works well with a wide range of lenses
High-resolution electronic viewfinder is excellent for critical focus in bright conditions
cons: Heavier at around 823g, making it less comfortable for long handheld shoots than smaller bodies
Smaller Micro Four Thirds sensor struggles more in low light than full-frame alternatives
Fan-cooled and heat-sensitive in long 5.7K recordings, which can cause overheating warnings
searchable_text: Professional hybrid camera for filmmakers, documentary videographers, and content creators needing high-quality video. 5.7K recording, 4K120 slow motion, and strong in-body stabilisation suit commercial work, short films, and event coverage. Good for shooters who also want stills in a compact system.

name: OM System OM-3 (2024)
summary: A compact, weather-sealed landscape and wildlife body with class-leading in-body stabilisation and computational photography modes.

Computational modes like Handheld High Res Shot and Live ND suit landscapes
Sealed body with a bright electronic viewfinder suits rough outdoor shooting
cons: Micro Four Thirds sensor offers less low-light and shallow depth-of-field performance than full frame
Video is limited to 4K30, which lags behind rivals for filmmaking
Menu system is deep and takes time to master for newcomers
searchable_text: Weather-sealed mirrorless camera for landscape, wildlife and travel photographers who hike with their gear. Micro Four Thirds sensor with powerful in-body stabilisation, handheld high-resolution and night modes, and a compact lightweight build. Strong choice for outdoor stills, less suited to cinematic video work.

name: Insta360 Ace Pro (2022)

Leica-co-engineered lens offers richer colour and sharper detail

Hot-swappable battery requires carrying spare cells to avoid downtime
Water resistance needs the included case beyond shallow depths, adding bulk
searchable_text: Action camera for vloggers, cyclists and adventure travellers who want higher image quality than typical sports cameras. Records 8K30 and 4K120 with FlowState stabilisation, a larger sensor and a Leica-tuned lens. Good for low-light street clips and dynamic outdoor footage.

name: Canon EOS R100
summary: An affordable, lightweight RF-S mirrorless camera that makes a simple first step into interchangeable-lens photography.
pros: Very light body at around 356g makes it easy to carry all day
Fully compatible with Canon's RF-S lenses, including the cheap kit zoom
Simple guided menus and Creative Assist help beginners learn exposure
cons: No electronic or optical viewfinder, so bright sunlight makes framing difficult
Digital stabilisation only, with no in-body IS for handheld video
4K video is limited to 30p with a noticeable crop

name: Sony ZV-1F
summary: A compact vlogging camera with a wide-angle lens, flip-out screen and background defocus button for talking-head videos.
pros: Built-in 20mm-equivalent wide lens suits selfie-style vlogging without extra gear
Background defocus button instantly blurs the backdrop for a cinematic look
Fully articulating screen and built-in directional microphone are vlogger-friendly
cons: Fixed lens with a relatively small maximum aperture limits low-light performance
No viewfinder, and the flip-out screen is smaller than a dedicated vlogging camera
Maximum video is 4K30, with no 4K60 option for smooth motion

name: GoPro HERO13 Black
summary: A rugged, waterproof action camera delivering 5.3K60 footage with HyperSmooth stabilisation for fast-moving adventures.
pros: HyperSmooth 6.0 stabilisation keeps mountain biking and skiing footage steady
Waterproof to 10m without a housing, ready for snorkelling straight out of the box
Quick-swap battery and mounting system make it easy to attach to helmets and bikes
cons: Small 1/1.9-inch sensor struggles in dim indoor and evening conditions
Battery life is modest and shortens quickly when shooting 5.3K
Fixed wide field of view can make subjects look distant without careful framing

name: OM System OM-1 Mark II
summary: A weather-sealed, fast-shooting Micro Four Thirds camera with powerful in-body stabilisation for landscape and wildlife work.
pros: In-body stabilisation rated up to around 7.5 stops gives sharp handheld shots at slow shutter speeds
Computational modes like handheld high-res shot suit landscape and tripod-free work
Robust, freezeproof and dustproof body with a fast, responsive electronic viewfinder
cons: Micro Four Thirds sensor offers less low-light and depth-of-field control than full frame
Expensive for a camera with a 20MP sensor compared with rivals
Menu system is dense and takes time to customise for new users

name: DJI Osmo Action 4
summary: A compact action camera with a larger 1/1.3-inch sensor and 4K120 slow motion for travel and family adventures.
pros: Larger 1/1.3-inch sensor handles low light noticeably better than most action cameras
Three-axis mechanical stabilisation produces smooth handheld walking footage
Dual screens allow framing and checking shots from the front and the back
cons: Fixed lens with no zoom, so distant subjects remain small in the frame
Front screen is small and difficult to use in bright sunlight
Relies on a proprietary battery and charging accessories that are not interchangeable with older DJI models

name: Sony Alpha 7C II (2023)
summary: A compact full-frame camera with pro-level autofocus and five-axis stabilisation, built for serious hybrid shooters on the move.

searchable_text: Full-frame hybrid camera for travel, landscape, portrait, and documentary work. Compact body with five-axis stabilisation, strong autofocus, 33MP stills, and 4K video. Suits photographers wanting full-frame quality without the bulk of larger Sony bodies.

name: Sony Alpha 7 V (2024)

33MP sensor delivers rich detail and wide dynamic range for commercial and editorial photography

4K60 recording is oversampled from 6K but still uses a crop in some modes, limiting wide-angle work
Battery life, while improved, is still shorter than dedicated video-first cameras during long shoots
searchable_text: Full-frame mirrorless camera for professionals, commercial photographers and hybrid shooters. 33-megapixel sensor, advanced subject-tracking autofocus, in-body stabilisation and 4K60 video. Ideal for portraits, weddings, landscapes, product shoots and filmmakers who need reliable stills and video from one body.

name: Panasonic Lumix FZ80D (2022)

pros: Long 60x zoom covers wide landscapes and distant wildlife without changing lenses

Lens-based Power O.I.S. stabilisation keeps long telephoto handheld shots reasonably steady

Bulkier than most compacts, so it is less convenient to carry in a jacket pocket

searchable_text: Superzoom bridge-style camera for travellers, families and beginners who want one lens for everything. Long zoom, electronic viewfinder and stabilisation suit holidays, days out, zoo visits and sightseeing. Best for casual photographers who value versatility and simplicity over image quality in dim conditions.

name: Sony Alpha 7R V (2022)

Five-axis in-body stabilisation with a 9.44-million-dot EVF that is excellent for critical focus

Lack of a fully articulating screen limits low-angle and vlogging use
At £3,499 it costs considerably more than the Alpha 7 IV for most users' needs
searchable_text: High-end full-frame mirrorless camera for landscape, architecture, studio and commercial photography. Offers a 61MP sensor, 8K video, pixel-shift high-resolution mode and advanced autofocus with subject recognition. Best suited to professionals and serious enthusiasts who need exceptional resolution and detail.

name: Nikon Z6III (2024)

Fully articulating touchscreen and a 3.69-million-dot EVF suit both shooting styles

Battery life is modest for a camera that is often used for extended video shoots
Autofocus tracking is competent but trails Sony's subject recognition in tricky scenes
searchable_text: Full-frame hybrid mirrorless camera for filmmakers, wedding photographers and sports shooters. Features 6K RAW video, 4K120 slow motion, in-body stabilisation and a fast partially stacked sensor. Ideal for creators who shoot both high-quality stills and professional-grade video on a single body.

name: Canon EOS R5 Mark II (2024)

8K recording uses large files and demands fast CFexpress cards and substantial storage
Battery life is modest for such a high-resolution body, so spare batteries are essential on location
searchable_text: Professional mirrorless camera for commercial photographers, wedding and event shooters, and hybrid filmmakers needing high resolution. Features 45MP full-frame sensor, 8K video, fast stacked-sensor autofocus, and strong in-body stabilisation. Suited to studio, editorial, and commercial work requiring detailed, flexible images.

name: Sony Alpha 7CR (2023)

Large 61MP raw files fill memory cards and slow down editing on older computers
searchable_text: Full-frame mirrorless camera for landscape, portrait, and fine-art photographers who want high resolution in a compact body. Features 61MP sensor, 4K60 video, in-body stabilisation, and an electronic viewfinder. Good for travellers wanting detailed images without carrying a heavy full-size camera.

name: Nikon Z8 (2023)

Offers internal 8K30 and 4K120 recording alongside N-RAW for professional workflows

Requires a large SD card investment, as high-bitrate video fills storage fast
searchable_text: Professional full-frame mirrorless camera for wildlife, sports, commercial, and event photographers. Features 45.7MP sensor, 8K video, advanced subject-detection autofocus, and in-body stabilisation. Best for working pros who need speed, reliability, and high-resolution files across demanding shoots.

name: Panasonic Lumix S1 II (2023)

Five-axis in-body stabilisation combined with a large, bright electronic viewfinder

Fan-less cooling can cause overheating warnings during extended 6K recording

Offers 6K recording, dual native ISO, L-mount lens system, and in-body stabilisation. Well suited to documentary, corporate, and short-film work where image quality and colour grading flexibility matter most.

name: Fujifilm Instax Mini 12 (2022)

searchable_text: Fujifilm Instax Mini 12 instant camera for families, kids, parties and casual gifting. Prints credit-card-sized photos instantly, with automatic exposure, selfie mirror and close-up lens. Ideal for first-time users who want fun, tangible snapshots rather than digital files.

name: Panasonic Lumix S1RII (2024)

Compatible with Leica/Sigma/Panasonic L-mount lenses, giving access to a wide choice of high-quality optics

searchable_text: Panasonic Lumix S1RII full-frame mirrorless camera for professional portrait, landscape, studio and commercial photographers. Features a 61MP sensor, 8K30 video, five-axis in-body stabilisation and L-mount lens compatibility. Best suited to experienced shooters who need maximum resolution and flexibility.
